notes.title: Language localization and Made in Brazil Sale
notes.content:
Hello my Frogs 🐸

Two great news

Dagger Froggy is at the Made in Brazil Sale 2025
Incredible Brazilian games with discounts and we gave them a try!
Don't miss it!

And we have new languages ​​available

localization of new languages:

- Japanese
- Russian
- Italian
- French

Issues that were previously fixed:

Thank you everyone for your feedback, criticisms, and suggestions
This community is getting bigger and bigger, and I'm very happy to see all the analyses, screenshots of records broken by all of you.

Thank you very much!
Solluco 🐸

notes.title: GENERAL IMPROVEMENTS V1.0.2
notes.content:
Update to fix minor issues and improve game life.

[h3]Bugs and Improvements:[/h3]

- Fixed a bug that caused the Orb Special to not work
- Fixed a bug that meant you couldn't get achievements on released maps
- Fixed a bug in the 15th character's sprite 
- Added an indicator for which upgrade you are choosing when pressing TAB or SELECT
- Added text in character selection, explaining how to unlock characters

[h3]Change in Characters:[/h3]

- Characters are now unlocked upon reaching Level 6 of their respective upgrade
- Text has been added to indicate how to unlock the character
- The 2nd character gained +2 speed
- The 6th character gained +2 Daggers
- The 8th character gained +2 black heart
- The 15th character gained +2 piercing
(The Upgrades to unlock them are still the same)

[h3]Upgrade Changes:[/h3]

- Drilling special went from +30 to +50
- Mini Dagger Special now has a 30% chance to create more Mini Daggers in the opposite direction
- Orbiting dagger special now creates 1 more dagger around you
- Healing Orb Special went from 6 seconds to 5 seconds
- Black Heart Special went from 50% to 100%, but does not increase the damage radius

[h3]Enemy Changes:[/h3]

- Now the big Slime has a little more speed
- The size of the Snail's explosion has been increased

[h3]Final Note:[/h3]

First of all, I'm sorry for those who unlocked the characters the old way, but the vast majority were getting all the achievements before being able to unlock 1 Little Frog, the characters were made to facilitate the progress of the game and not slow it down.
I hope you understand. 

Thank you very much for playing
Solluco 🐸

notes.title: GENERAL IMPROVEMENTS V1.0.1
notes.content:
A small update is available to improve the lifespan of the game!

CHANGES IN UPGRADES:

- Stone stature now attacks in 4 directions
- Poison is now applied by +8% instead of 5%
- Now you can see the list of upgrades in the level up!

CHARACTER CHANGE: 9 (no spoilers 😉)

- Now in addition to starting with 2 points in the stone statue, you also start with 2 points in poison!
And it can also be unlocked by maxing out any of the two upgrades!

- CHANGE IN BOSS AND FINAL PHASE:

- Now in 15 minute mode the boss has 50% more health
- An additional attack in the last phase of the Boss
- The last phase received some visual changes
- The call sign
- Now to access the last phase you need 20 permanent upgrades, previously it was 25
- An end credits room was added after killing the boss.

These were small changes, but very significant for the life of the game, in this update the ultra wide resolution problem has not yet been resolved
But know that I will work on this in the next updates

Thank you very much for your patience 

Solluco 🐸
